bullets.text: T-Mobile's Legal Troubles Intensify - **Verizon** and **AT&T** challenge T-Mobile's switching strategy, raising transparency concerns.
AT&T Partners with Amazon - **AT&T** integrates **Amazon Leo** satellite services to enhance connectivity in remote areas.
Dispelling Open RAN Myths - **Wind River** highlights that **Open RAN** is now a mature technology suitable for diverse deployments.
Bell's AI Growth Surge - **Bell Canada** reports a 60% year-over-year growth in its AI-powered enterprise solutions.
5G Slicing Validated - **Ericsson**, **FET**, and **OPPO** confirm performance-based 5G slicing can enhance connectivity.
Amazon Seeks Delay for Leo - **Amazon** requests an extension to launch its **Leo** satellite constellation by 2028.
Preparing for Quantum Threats - Experts warn telecoms must address quantum security risks before the 2030s.
Verizon's AI Strategy - **Verizon** outlines plans to leverage metro fiber and private 5G for enterprise AI applications.
Network Digital Twins Revolutionize Telecom - **Network Digital Twins** provide real-time insights for smarter telecom operations.
AT&T Expands Fiber Network - **AT&T** completes acquisition of **Lumen's** fiber business, enhancing its service footprint.
